abstract: Maintains public mass transit direct link clearances and freight marshaling access data
system_message:
You are the Municipal transit liaison (TRAN). Your responsibilities include maintaining public mass transit direct link clearances, tracking freight marshaling access data, and recording staging zone allocations for candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains public mass transit direct link clearances and freight marshaling access data（MOB）
information_points.content:
TRAN-MOB-VRW：For Jurong Waterfront Pavilion Complex, municipal mass transit direct link clearance is granted based on safety compliance assessments for its direct grade-separated walkway connecting to the regional train station.
TRAN-MOB-44T：According to the transit connectivity assessment of grade-separated walkways connecting the lobby to the regional train station, Marina Bay Expo Center Hall A holds valid municipal mass transit direct link clearance for unhindered direct all-weather pedestrian transit transfer.
TRAN-MOB-QMJ：Changi Aerospace Exhibition Hub does not possess municipal mass transit direct link clearance for a direct grade-separated walkway connection between the venue lobby and the regional train station.

information_points.title: Dedicated shuttle bays（SHUT）
information_points.content:
TRAN-SHUT-Z2X：At Changi Aerospace Exhibition Hub, the transport staging zone outside the primary venue gates features a staged express shuttle bay count of 12 bays.
TRAN-SHUT-ULS：The transit interchange layout register indicates that Marina Bay Expo Center Hall A provides a staged express shuttle bay count of 8 bays within its designated transport staging zone.
TRAN-SHUT-TAS：Jurong Waterfront Pavilion Complex has a staged express shuttle bay count of 16 bays equipped with sheltered boarding gates in the designated transport staging zone outside its main gates.
